title: HMS Blonde orange sphere rises from the ocean
place_text: near the Cook Islands, South Pacific

tellings.quote: and he writes in his diary at 3:30 a.m. on August uh 12th, 1825. This is 200 years ago. He said the Night Watch reported this orange spherical object rise from the ocean uh at 7°.

plain: At 3:30 in the morning on August 12, 1825, the night watch on HMS Blonde, a British Royal Navy ship sailing near the Cook Islands in the South Pacific, is said to have seen an orange ball of light rise out of the ocean. The researcher Richard Dolan tells this, drawing on the diary of a man aboard named Andrew Bloxom, written in 1825, which records that the watch "reported this orange spherical object rise from the ocean". Dolan brings it up to show that sightings like this go back about 200 years.
